title: 37 readmes run over 100 lines; agents load them every time

chat.text: Measured by a script, not a minion: 382 readmes and skill files, about 20,000 lines. 37 are over 100 lines (longest: core/new/1 591, the mastermind skill 504, Servex 389, AI 2 383). 66 linked files are over 30 KB (Panel decisions.md 117 KB, ai/tasks.json 99 KB). 282 links look broken and 428 code folders have no readme (both rough first counts). Full list: /framework/ai/2026-10-03/readme-weight/readme-weight.json. Next, when usage allows: trim the top ten into an index plus linked sub-pages.
